job_templates.title: FastAPI Backend Engineer
job_templates.description:
Job Title: Senior FastAPI Backend Engineer
Location: Remote / Hybrid
Requirements:
- 5+ years experience building production backends with Python & FastAPI
- Deep proficiency with SQLAlchemy async ORM, PostgreSQL schema design, and query optimization
- Experience building microservices, Docker containerization, and REST API standards
- Hands-on experience with asynchronous rate-limiting, circuit-breakers, and caching architectures (Redis/SQLite)
- Strong understanding of unit testing with pytest and async fixtures.

job_templates.title: Full Stack Python / React
job_templates.description:
Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Python & React)
Location: Remote
Requirements:
- 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience
- Python, FastAPI or Django on the backend
- Modern React, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS or Bootstrap 5 on the frontend
- Experience integrating third-party APIs, OAuth, and LLM providers
- Strong database knowledge (PostgreSQL, SQLite).

job_templates.title: DevOps & Cloud Platform
job_templates.description:
Job Title: Cloud & DevOps Platform Engineer
Location: Remote / Hybrid
Requirements:
- 5+ years managing Linux infrastructure and cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Extensive hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm
- CI/CD automation pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
- Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
- Python or Bash scripting for system automation.

job_templates.title: Talent Acquisition & HR Lead
job_templates.description:
Job Title: Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist & HR Lead
Location: Remote / On-site
Requirements:
- 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting and HR talent intelligence experience
- Demonstrated track record sourcing candidates via Boolean search, LinkedIn X-Ray, and developer communities
- Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and candidate evaluation benchmarking
- Strong competency in structured behavioral interviews and merit-based talent screening
- Excellent stakeholder communication and compensation negotiation skills.

job_templates.title: Growth Marketing Manager
job_templates.description:
Job Title: Growth & Digital Marketing Manager
Location: Remote / Hybrid
Requirements:
- 4+ years experience in B2B SaaS growth marketing, SEO, and paid acquisition
- Proven track record increasing conversion rates (CRO) and MRR with quantified pipeline growth
- Deep proficiency with Google Analytics 4, HubSpot, Mixpanel, and SEMrush
- Hands-on experience running multi-channel campaigns (LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, Email nurturing)
- Strong data analysis skills (SQL or Python a plus) to measure CAC, LTV, and retention.

job_templates.title: Financial Analyst & Controller
job_templates.description:
Job Title: Senior Financial Analyst & Corporate Controller
Location: Hybrid / On-site
Requirements:
- 5+ years of financial planning & analysis (FP&A), budget forecasting, and corporate reporting
- Advanced financial modeling in Excel, Power BI, and ERP systems (SAP/NetSuite)
- CPA or CFA qualification preferred; strong knowledge of US GAAP / IFRS standards
- Demonstrated success in cost optimization, margin expansion, and audit defense
- Experience presenting quarterly board decks and capital allocation models.
